narrative.overview: Original illustrated listening-room warmth surrounds a personal broadcast. Final local SVG refinement adds layered reflective glazing, occluded local light pools, curved ceramic/terracotta response, varied leaf contours, turntable thickness and cabinet recess depth; no photographic or physical-simulation claim.
keyCharacteristics: Broad broadcast lettering and direct channel controls.
Authored material detail with directional light and overlapping depth.
Ordinary full-size transcripts, not CRT-bound prose or modal cards.
dos: Do keep directional warmth, rainy contrast, cloth/wood/glass details and stable framing together.
Do keep primary prose at 16px or more and normal document scroll.
donts: Don't introduce fake BASIC, OS booting, copied source objects or invented professional proof.
Don't box paragraphs into a generic card grid.
